name: Chicharrones Guisados (Stewed Fried Pork Rinds)

ingredients.name: neutral cooking oil, such as vegetable or canola
chipotle chilis, canned in adobo sauce
chopped fresh cilantro leaves, fine stems plus more to garnish

instructions.primary_message: Chop the onion medium. Mince the garlic. Remove the husks from the tomatillos, then quarter them. Cut the canned plum tomatoes into quarters. Roughly chop the serrano pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium onion
4 medium cloves garlic
0.68 kg tomatillos
3 medium canned plum tomatoes
1 serrano pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are starting to brown, about 8 minutes. Add garlic and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add oregano and cumin and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Add tomatillos, tomatoes, serrano pepper, and chipotle peppers. Scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pan and reduce heat to medium. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until tomatillos and tomatoes are softened and their juices have reduced to a thick sauce-like consistency. Add 2 cups chicken stock (or water), bring to a simmer, and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Transfer mixture to a food processor. Add cilantro and process until mostly smooth, with an oatmeal-like consistency. Season to taste with salt and pepper.

Return the puréed sauce back to the pot. Add chicharrones and bring sauce to a simmer. Simmer until the chicharrones are tender, 10 to 15 minutes, adding additional stock or water as necessary to adjust the consistency of the liquid. Serve with choice of garnishes.

description: Deep fried pork rinds get simmered in a tomatillo and tomato-based sauce.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Queso fresco to garnish; Mexican-style crema to garnish (optional)

Optional substitutions: canned plum tomatoes → fresh plum tomatoes

Notes: The chicharrones guisados can be served with tortillas, sopes, rice, or beans.
author: Chichi Wang
